# Overview

PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC currently operates with business processes spanning the data, technology, and marketing teams, specifically in relation to pipeline and customer acquisition reporting activities. These processes utilize a range of systems and platforms, including Salesforce and Tamarac for client and portfolio management, Azure Blob Storage for unstructured data storage, Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse for data integration and analytics, and Power BI for business intelligence and reporting. QuickBooks is also identified as a data source, with planned integration into the reporting framework.

The analytics and reporting environment is anchored by a Power BI reporting suite, which serves as the primary tool for analyzing data drawn from Salesforce, Tamarac, Azure Blob Storage, and, prospectively, QuickBooks. Cloud and platform infrastructure are built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse, enabling batch data processing and the integration of disparate data assets. At present, the principal integration challenge lies in ingesting financial data from QuickBooks for Customer Acquisition Cost reporting and ensuring underlying data quality. Current manual processes or additional operational inefficiencies have not been detailed in the documentation.
